package postgres

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"reflect"
	"strings"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/domain"
	"github.com/jackc/pgx/v5"
)

type nextActionRow struct {
	values []any
	err    error
}

func (r nextActionRow) Scan(dest ...any) error {
	if r.err != nil {
		return r.err
	}
	if len(dest) != len(r.values) {
		return fmt.Errorf("scan count %d, want %d", len(dest), len(r.values))
	}
	for i, v := range r.values {
		reflect.ValueOf(dest[i]).Elem().Set(reflect.ValueOf(v))
	}
	return nil
}

type nextActionRows struct {
	pgx.Rows
	values [][]any
	index  int
}

func (r *nextActionRows) Next() bool { r.index++; return r.index <= len(r.values) }
func (r *nextActionRows) Scan(dest ...any) error {
	return (nextActionRow{values: r.values[r.index-1]}).Scan(dest...)
}
func (r *nextActionRows) Close()     {}
func (r *nextActionRows) Err() error { return nil }

type nextActionSnapshotFixture struct {
	student, path   string
	status          domain.LearningPathStatus
	facts           []any
	instances       []string
	missingSelected bool
	answers         [][]any
	correlated      bool
	t               *testing.T
}

func (f nextActionSnapshotFixture) QueryRow(_ context.Context, sql string, args ...any) pgx.Row {
	f.t.Helper()
	if len(args) == 0 || args[0] != f.student {
		f.t.Fatalf("snapshot query is not owner scoped: %s %v", sql, args)
	}
	now := time.Date(2026, 10, 3, 0, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)
	switch {
	case strings.Contains(sql, "FROM student_learning_context"):
		if f.path == "" {
			return nextActionRow{err: pgx.ErrNoRows}
		}
		return nextActionRow{values: []any{f.student, f.path, int64(7), now}}
	case strings.Contains(sql, "FROM student_learning_path WHERE") && len(args) == 2:
		if f.missingSelected {
			return nextActionRow{err: pgx.ErrNoRows}
		}
		if len(args) != 2 || args[1] != f.path {
			f.t.Fatalf("wrong selected path: %v", args)
		}
		return nextActionRow{values: []any{f.path, f.student, "33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333", "go.backend", "r10", domain.LearningPathPolicyVersion, "planner-v1", "planned", "Learn Go", f.status, false, int64(9), now, now}}
	case strings.Contains(sql, "FROM student_learning_action"):
		instance := args[1].(string)
		var opened *time.Time
		lifecycle := domain.PracticeLearningActionReserved
		if instance == f.instances[0] {
			opened = &now
			lifecycle = domain.PracticeLearningActionOpen
		}
		path, item, requirement, version := "", "", "", int64(0)
		if f.correlated {
			path = "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111"
			item = "99999999-9999-4999-8999-999999999999"
			requirement = "66666666-6666-4666-8666-666666666666"
			version = 9
		}
		return nextActionRow{values: []any{"44444444-4444-4444-8444-444444444444", f.student, instance, "55555555-5555-4555-8555-555555555555", "sha256:" + strings.Repeat("a", 64), "practice", []byte(`[{"type":"concept","key":"go.test","version":"v1"}]`), lifecycle, path, version, 0, opened, (*time.Time)(nil), "", "hash", item, requirement}}
	case strings.Contains(sql, "SELECT i.frozen_requirements"):
		return nextActionRow{values: []any{[]byte(`[{"requirement_id":"66666666-6666-4666-8666-666666666666","activity_id":"77777777-7777-4777-8777-777777777777","type":"practice_completed","required":false,"source_reference":{"id":"55555555-5555-4555-8555-555555555555","revision_id":"55555555-5555-4555-8555-555555555555"},"satisfied":false}]`)}}
	default:
		return nextActionRow{values: f.facts}
	}
}

func TestNextActionSnapshotRetainsOptionalBindingRequirementWithoutSelectedPath(t *testing.T) {
	f := nextActionSnapshotFixture{t: t, student: "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222", facts: []any{true, false, false, false, true, false}, instances: []string{"bbbbbbbb-bbbb-4bbb-8bbb-bbbbbbbbbbbb"}, correlated: true}
	s, err := readNextActionSnapshot(context.Background(), f, f.student)
	if err != nil || len(s.Bindings) != 1 || len(s.BindingRequirements) != 1 || domain.RequiredNextActionBinding(s, s.Bindings[0]) {
		t.Fatalf("lost authoritative optional binding facts: %+v err=%v", s, err)
	}
}
func (f nextActionSnapshotFixture) Query(_ context.Context, sql string, args ...any) (pgx.Rows, error) {
	switch {
	case strings.Contains(sql, "FROM student_task_answer"):
		if len(args) != 2 || args[0] != f.student || args[1] != f.path {
			f.t.Fatalf("wrong answer ownership: %v", args)
		}
		return &nextActionRows{values: f.answers}, nil
	case strings.Contains(sql, "FROM student_learning_path_item"):
		if len(args) != 1 || args[0] != f.path {
			f.t.Fatalf("wrong item path: %v", args)
		}
		requirements := []byte(`[{"requirement_id":"66666666-6666-4666-8666-666666666666","activity_id":"77777777-7777-4777-8777-777777777777","type":"theory_acknowledged","required":true,"source_reference":{"id":"88888888-8888-4888-8888-888888888888"},"satisfied":true}]`)
		return &nextActionRows{values: [][]any{{"lesson", "88888888-8888-4888-8888-888888888888", 0, domain.LearningPathItemCompleted, []byte(`[]`), "lesson_requirements_satisfied", "99999999-9999-4999-8999-999999999999", "aaaaaaaa-aaaa-4aaa-8aaa-aaaaaaaaaaaa", requirements, []byte(`{"title":"frozen"}`)}}}, nil
	case strings.Contains(sql, "FROM student_learning_action"):
		if len(args) != 1 || args[0] != f.student {
			f.t.Fatalf("wrong binding owner: %v", args)
		}
		rows := &nextActionRows{}
		for _, id := range f.instances {
			rows.values = append(rows.values, []any{id})
		}
		return rows, nil
	default:
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("unexpected query: %s", sql)
	}
}

func TestNextActionSnapshotCarriesOnlyExactCorrelatedOfficialAttempts(t *testing.T) {
	f := nextActionSnapshotFixture{t: t, student: "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222", path: "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111", status: domain.LearningPathStatusActive,
		answers: [][]any{{"99999999-9999-4999-8999-999999999999", "66666666-6666-4666-8666-666666666666", "dddddddd-dddd-4ddd-8ddd-dddddddddddd", domain.StudentTaskAnswerStatusUnderReview}}}
	s, err := readNextActionSnapshot(context.Background(), f, f.student)
	if err != nil || len(s.Answers) != 1 || s.Answers[0].Status != domain.StudentTaskAnswerStatusUnderReview || s.Answers[0].RequirementID != "66666666-6666-4666-8666-666666666666" {
		t.Fatalf("lost official correlated attempt: %+v err=%v", s, err)
	}
}
func TestNextActionSnapshotReadsCompletedSelectedPathAndFrozenFacts(t *testing.T) {
	f := nextActionSnapshotFixture{t: t, student: "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222", path: "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111", status: domain.LearningPathStatusCompleted}
	s, err := readNextActionSnapshot(context.Background(), f, f.student)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if s.Context.Version != 7 || s.SelectedPath == nil || s.SelectedPath.Version != 9 || s.SelectedPath.Status != domain.LearningPathStatusCompleted || !s.SelectedPath.Items[0].FrozenRequirements[0].Satisfied {
		t.Fatalf("snapshot lost authoritative facts: %+v", s)
	}
}
func TestNextActionSnapshotRejectsMissingSelectedOwnerPath(t *testing.T) {
	f := nextActionSnapshotFixture{t: t, student: "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222", path: "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111", missingSelected: true}
	if _, err := readNextActionSnapshot(context.Background(), f, f.student); !errors.Is(err, domain.ErrStateChanged) {
		t.Fatalf("missing selected path accepted: %v", err)
	}
}
func TestNextActionSnapshotNoSelectionLifecycle(t *testing.T) {
	for _, tc := range []struct {
		name  string
		facts []any
		want  string
	}{
		{"onboarding", []any{false, false, false, false, false, false}, "onboarding_required"},
		{"planning", []any{true, false, true, false, false, false}, "planning_in_progress"},
		{"diagnostic", []any{true, false, false, true, false, false}, "diagnostic_required"},
		{"selection", []any{true, false, false, false, true, true}, "path_selection_required"},
		{"completed", []any{true, false, false, false, false, true}, "path_completed"},
		{"needs_plan", []any{true, false, false, false, false, false}, ""},
	} {
		t.Run(tc.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			f := nextActionSnapshotFixture{t: t, student: "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222", facts: tc.facts}
			s, err := readNextActionSnapshot(context.Background(), f, f.student)
			if err != nil || s.LifecycleReason != tc.want || s.SelectedPath != nil {
				t.Fatalf("lifecycle=%+v err=%v", s, err)
			}
		})
	}
}
func TestNextActionSnapshotRetainsAllOwnedActiveBindings(t *testing.T) {
	f := nextActionSnapshotFixture{t: t, student: "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222", facts: []any{true, false, false, false, false, false}, instances: []string{"bbbbbbbb-bbbb-4bbb-8bbb-bbbbbbbbbbbb", "cccccccc-cccc-4ccc-8ccc-cccccccccccc"}}
	s, err := readNextActionSnapshot(context.Background(), f, f.student)
	if err != nil || len(s.Bindings) != 2 || s.Bindings[0].LifecycleStatus != domain.PracticeLearningActionOpen || s.Bindings[1].LifecycleStatus != domain.PracticeLearningActionReserved {
		t.Fatalf("lost active binding: %+v err=%v", s, err)
	}
}
